notes: ἀκωλύτως is recast as the absolute none forbidding him, the supplied subject and object riding inside the unit, headed on the word glossing the κωλυ- stem (rules 84, 91).
τά takes the determiner and its nominal, headed on things and never on the determiner (rule 22); Ἰησοῦ and Χριστοῦ are split rather than sharing a head (rules 26, 28).
